notes.title: Balance, feedback and new relics
notes.content:
[p]Hi, [/p][p][/p][p]Feedback - thank you all for submitting it either on discord or in discussions here on steam. Here are the changes I made:[/p][list][*][p]Added VSync to options[/p][/*][*][p]Added building rotations - Q and E on keyboard, mouse side buttons or L1 R1 on controller. You can now rotate all buildings while placing them.[/p][/*][*][p]End turn has additional indicator when enemy would destroy main platform and end your run.[/p][/*][*][p]Building names now shown when hovering on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Tree and Rock info when hovering over them.[/p][/*][*][p]Woodcutter starting relic (Seed of Eternal Growth) now shows where the tree will be placed. If built over it will pick another spot to place it.[/p][/*][*][p]New tutorial info for adjacent placement to structures and energy not resetting between turns.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]New Relics - Added 8 new relics to the game for more unique runs. These relics will be from the start of the game and no need to be unlocked:[/p][list][*][p]Boundless Storehouses - For each resource that you are producing max at the end of combat, increase it's max by 1 (Butcher exclusive)[/p][/*][*][p]Wallbreacher - When playing a card of 3 or more Gem cost reduce enemy main structure Energy value by 3 (Woodcutter exclusive)[/p][/*][*][p]Earthen Slab - At the start of combat produce 1 Clay for every pickup collected (Miner exclusive)[/p][/*][*][p]Monument Charm - At the start of combat produce 1 Coal for every Monument in deck[/p][/*][*][p]Talisman of Refinement - Discarded cards are upgraded for the combat[/p][/*][*][p]Starstone - Draw 1 additional card at the start of each day[/p][/*][*][p]Rubble Cache - At the start of combat produce 1 Stone for every card destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Witherleaf Bowl - After playing upgraded card, downgrade it permanently and produce 1 of each resource that you produced this combat[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Balance - After playing more myself and from your feedback some changes were made:[/p][list][*][p]Levels:[/p][list][*][p]Made Harder:[/p][list][*][p]Swamp fight 3[/p][/*][*][p]Snow fight 4[/p][/*][*][p]River fight 4[/p][/*][*][p]River fight 5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Made Easier:[/p][list][*][p]Mountains fight 2[/p][/*][*][p]Mountains fight 3[/p][/*][*][p]Forest fight 4[/p][/*][*][p]Wall fight 4[/p][/*][*][p]Swamp fight 4[/p][/*][*][p]Sands fight 5[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cards:[/p][list][*][p]Buffed:[/p][list][*][p]Shelter[/p][/*][*][p]Crypt[/p][/*][*][p]Farmhouse[/p][/*][*][p]Vegetable Garden[/p][/*][*][p]Sawmill[/p][/*][*][p]Carpentry[/p][/*][*][p]Grinding Mill[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Quarry[/p][/*][*][p]Hunting Cabin[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Nerfed:[/p][list][*][p]Gemstone Mine[/p][/*][*][p]Woodcarver[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Relics - some relics changed rarity, but none where buffed or nerfed
[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Have fun playing,
Emilijus[/p][p]






[/p]

notes.title: 1st Balance update and bug fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi, after almost a week after launch it is time to check out balance of relics, cards and combat.
[/p][h2]Summary:[/h2][h3]Combat changes:[/h3][p]Enemy Camp, Swamp Tower, Ancient Mine and Mountain Village got harder.
Forest Castle, Snow Stronghold, River Castle got easier.[/p][h3]Relic changes:[/h3][p]Sapling of Life & Unexpected Goods - got buffed[/p][h3]Card changes:[/h3][p]Furnace & Alchemist - nerfed
Camp, Theater, House Builder, Shelter, Wagon Builder - buffed
[/p][h2]Stats[/h2][h3]Combat changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Enemy Camp - Fight 1 - Main structure cost 7 -> 9[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy Camp - Fight 2 - Main structure cost 18 -> 21[/p][/*][*][p]Swamp Tower - Fight 2 - Starting towers 3 -> 4[/p][/*][*][p]Swamp Tower - Fight 2 - Main structure cost 14 -> 16[/p][/*][*][p]Swamp Tower - Fight 3 - Starting towers 4 -> 5[/p][/*][*][p]Swamp Tower - Fight 3 - Main structure cost 28 -> 32[/p][/*][*][p]Mountain Village - Fight 3 - Additional Tower cots 2 -> 3[/p][/*][*][p]Mountain Village - Fight 3 - Main structure cost 34 -> 38[/p][/*][*][p]Forest Castle - Fight 4 - Building towers increases after 4 turns -> 5 turns[/p][/*][*][p]Forest Castle - Fight 4 - Starting towers 4 -> 3[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Stronghold - Fight 5 - Starting towers 3 -> 0[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Stronghold - Fight 5 - Building towers increases after 4 turns -> 5 turns[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Starting towers 4 -> 1[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Building towers increases after 3 turns -> 5 turns[/p][/*][*][p]Snow Stronghold - Fight 6 - Additional Tower cots 5 -> 4[/p][/*][*][p]River Castle - Fight 5 - Main structure cost 72-> 67[/p][/*][*][p]River Castle - Fight 6 - Main structure cost 100-> 92[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient Mine - Fight 6 - Starting towers 4 -> 6[/p][/*][*][p]Ancient Mine - Fight 6 - Building towers increases after 3 turns -> 2 turns[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Relic changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Sapling of Life - When you place a structure size 4 or bigger create forest space in an adjacent space -> When you place a structure size 4 or bigger reduce random enemy defense by 1 Energy[/p][/*][*][p]Unexpected Goods - You can buy resources for the reserve in the market -> You can buy resources for the reserve in the market. Add 1 wood to reserve each time you visit market[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Card changes:[/h3][list][*][p]Furnace - Gem cost 0 -> 1[/p][/*][*][p]Alchemist - Gem cost 1 -> 2[/p][/*][*][p]Camp - At the end of turn pay 1 day to destroy enemy tower -> At the end of turn pay 1 day to destroy 2 enemy towers[/p][/*][*][p]Theater - When you place a building that is touching 4 or more other buildings draw a card -> When you place a building that is touching 3 or more other buildings draw a card.[/p][/*][*][p]House Builder - Produces 1 additional lumber[/p][/*][*][p]Shelter - Produces 1 additional wood[/p][/*][*][p]Wagon Builder - Get 1 additional lumber if places next to enough empty spaces[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug fixes and improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Enemy indicator now pulsates correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Additional info when hovering on enemy towers[/p][/*][*][p]Wording changes[/p][/*][*][p]You can check deck and relics at the end of combat, when picking rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements changes[/p][/*][*][p]Game no longer freezes when Lookout Tower destroys more than 5 towers[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fixes and suggestions

[p]Hi, some fixes reported by discord community:[/p][list][*][p]Wording fixes for some building[/p][/*][*][p]Pickups now float lower, as to not confuse which spot to collect from[/p][/*][*][p]Pike Maker occupied wrong spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Cards now show what spaces they take[/p][/*][*][p]Resources glow red when hovering card with paying effect, to show which resources will be reduced[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each level of difficulty now adds 20% increased score instead of 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Coalman now costs wood to play[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you all who shared your thoughts and suggestions!

notes.title: Seekers of Eclipse is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The Eclipse has begun... and so has your journey.

After years of work, I am thrilled to finally release Seekers of Eclipse into the world!
Thank you to everyone who followed development, wishlisted the game, or shared your excitement — now it’s your turn to lead.

 Play now on Steam:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577850/Seekers_of_Eclipse/

What awaits you:
[list]
[*]  Choose your path across branching maps
[*]  Build villages mid-battle with powerful cards
[*]  Manage resources, relics, and upgrades
[*]  Race against time before the eclipse arrives
[*]  Destroy enemy towers with energy-fueled attacks
[*]  Pick your leader with a unique deck and playstyle
[/list]

Every decision costs days. Every step matters. Will you reach the Eclipse in time?

Help us out!
If you enjoy the game, please consider:
[list]
[*] Leaving a review (even a short one means a lot)

Now go forth, Seeker — the homeland awaits. 🌒

notes.title: Reworked most of the game!
notes.content:
Hey, 

For the past 2 months I been reworking the game and I am finally ready to share. 

[list]
[*] New Cards - all cards have been reworked. There will be base cards that are always in play does not matter which character you are using (~50 cards), and each character will bring additional cards to the play (30+ cards). In the current version there will only be base cards, but Butcher cards will be added soon.
[*] New Relics - 31 total relics, only 8 are old, other are new. Changed that you can get some relics only in the market, or only after the fight.
[*] Every level got visual upgrade, no more tiles flying in space. 
[*] UI visual changes, for better readability.
[*] New card type Monuments - when placed card is not discarded, so each card can only build one Monument, which usually has passive ability, similar to relic.
[*] New resources added and some removed.
[*] New cards and relics are now locked with Packs, which can be unlocked with Stars. Each Pack contains 4-5 cards/relics.
[*] Game is faster, now instead of 50 days, you will only have 40, but the enemy cost is lower. 
[*] Game has saving. You can resume game from where you left off. 
[*] Cloud saves work correctly.
[*] Added Loading Screen. 
[/list]

Please try the game and share your thoughts either on Discord or F12 in game or here in the forums. 

Have fun playing!
Emilijus

notes.title: Orchard and new Relics
notes.content:
Hey,

Another update for the demo is here!

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic - Hunting tools - Each time a deck is shuffled produce either Labor or Weapons. Most difficult to get resources are given for free every few turns. And if your deck is small or you draw lots of cards this becomes very strong.
[*] New relic - Sacred Bones - Get an Energy for every building of yours destroyed. This makes cards like Ruins and Scavengers Guild just amazing. It helps with the last turns when you try to survive for the last energy production bearable and move a lot faster.
[*] New relic - Bottomless Horn - Every 3rd turn you get a free Gem. No downside to it, just more plays.
[*] New card - Orchard - a 2 cost card producing food and wood most common resources so a great fit to any deck. But in addition produces Labor for each card drawn this turn. So if your deck has lost of "draw a card" cards this is a perfect fit.
[*] Lucky Energy Relics got improved, now gives extra Energy not only for the exactly 7 but for 3 and 12 production too.
[*] Cards got nerfed: Carpenter, Charcoal kiln and Quarry.
[*] Cards got buffed: Manor, Pike Maker, Ruins and Weapon Recycler.
[*] Card UI fixes, now rarer cards have visuals. Card description got bigger so text should be easier to read. Faster appearing resource conversions near the card.
[*] Mountain Village and Snow Stronghold got easier, especially Snow Stronghold was too hard.
[*] Visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Again as always, thank you all who report the bugs and talk about improving the game. 

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Tiny Teams & More Content
notes.content:
Hey,

Seekers of Eclipse is now participating in the Tiny Teams Fest. Please Wishlist our game!

With it another update for the demo is here!

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic - Metals Delivery - Each turn gain stone, metal or weapon resource. This relic should help you out with buildings requiring these resource at the start and even if you haven't taken those buildings in a longer game it should help you out with energy production.
[*] New card - Wheat Field - a 0 cost building that produces nothing at the start but each turn it plants a field if there are empty spaces around which produces food. So good placement is especially important.
[*] New card - Sculptor - When placed creates a rock sculpture in an adjacent space, which acts as a rock for other building adjacency. This is a huge help for coal mine and quarry as it lets you create your own rocks.
[*] Star unlocks got cheaper as not many people unlocked them.
[*] Language fixes as not every letter was supported by the font we used.
[*] Visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Lucky new Cards
notes.content:
Hey,

Another update for the demo is here!

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic - Luck Pendant - Upgrades random card in hand at the start of each turn. Great boost for longer fights and makes upgrading in camp and in market less needed, but randomness of it can sometimes not give the upgrade that you wanted.
[*] All of card balance got reworked. Most of the cards still have the same purpose but values are different.
[*] A new resource - Lumber - Mostly created from wood so now there is a way to convert wood to energy better.
[*] 10 new cards:
[*] Library - Converts wood and food to labor. When played draw 2 cards.
[*] Smithy - Converts iron to weapons. When played draw 1 cards.
[*] Carpenter - Converts wood to lumber. When played get a random building card which costs 0 this turn.
[*] Garden - Produces food. Increases max energy from food by 1.
[*] Bakery - Produces cooked food. Increases max energy from cooked food by 1.
[*] Sawmill - Converts wood to lumber. On turn whenever you play a card it produces an additional lumber.
[*] Coopers - Converts wood and coal to lumber.
[*] Woodcarvers - Converts wood and food to lumber.
[*] Pike Maker - Converts lumber to Weapons. When played pick a card in discard to be placed on top of your deck.
[*] Builder - Converts lumber to labor.
[*] Two new soundtracks for the Snow Fortress and Desert Camp.
[*] Visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Shiny rocks in the Mountains
notes.content:
Hey,

Another update for the demo is here. 

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic - Shiny Rocks - Clearing fog where are rocks costs 0 energy. This helps out in two ways: with cheaper exploration and shows you where you can find rock.
[*] New level - Mountains village. Lots of rocks but not so many trees, so getting wood is harder, but mining is easier. This will appear instead of desert (current first level after tutorial). With this map all demo levels have 2 different options that you can encounter in each fight.
[*] Desert (first level) main structure and towers got cheaper to destroy.
[*] Visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Beautiful Relics
notes.content:
Hey,

Another update for the demo is here. 

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic - Traveling Merchants - Your starting platform will now acts as a market, when building adjacent buildings you will get random resource. With this it is less risky to take cards with a cost of resources that you don't produce, and a fun puzzle for the start of the fight.
[*] New relic - Glowing Necklace - Start combat with 5 energy. Either easier to save up for a tower that will attack you or start destroying towers on turn one.
[*] New relic - Strange Spices - On your first turn draw 3 additional cards and 2 extra gems. Huge first turn, great for higher cost buildings to place in the perfect spot.
[*] Fixes to the unlock system, as stars would not save correctly and bought relics would get locked again after game restart. In addition relic prices got smaller.
[*] Unlocked relics in the main menu will now show what they do. 
[*] Desert (first level) towers add less cost to other towers.
[*] Swamp (second level) each tower got cheaper.
[*] Snow (third level) will start building multiple towers per turn faster.
[*] Visual improvements on fog, outlines, lightning and more.
[*] When finishing tutorial you will now see what cards are added to the tutorial deck.
[/list]

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Magic spender and the swamp
notes.content:
Hey,

Another update for the demo is here. 

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic Magic Spender - Every turn if you spend at least 3 Energy you will get an additional action. This should be a great help for longer fights where you have to destroy towers, but not so good in the early turns of the fight.
[*] New Map - Swamp Tower - second fight now will be either the Forest Castle or Swamp Tower. In it you will find enemies that put down swamp spots that restrict your building possibilities. The map itself is smaller so more expanding needed and with a lot less trees, so wood resource becomes a lot more scarce.  
[*] Unlock system got reworked. Now you will not get to unlock one card and one relic at the end of the run, but you will collect stars that will be as currency for unlocking new cards and relics.
[*] Enemy Camp (First map) has new different tower that it builds.
[*] Tutorial improvements.
[*] Now all maps have rocks in them.
[*] Towers threat increased. After some days in each map enemies will start building multiple towers on the same turn.
[*] Balance changes.
[/list]

Hope to hear more of your feedback

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Bribery is happening.
notes.content:
Hey,

As promised a demo update is here. I will try to do these every two weeks, each update will have some new content and improvements based on your feedback.

What's new:
[list]
[*] New relic Bribery - you can destroy enemy towers by paying resources. This helps with excess resources you have and early on while energy production is low. But take care and don't spend them all as you still need energy to destroy main structure.
[*] New resource icons.
[*] Beta feature button added, as I don't have resources to translate new content to all the languages. So new content will only be in English and only active when this is pressed.
[*] Tutorial improved - lost of bug fixes and card explanation added.
[*] Resources fly when used, easier to understand what is paid and what is produced.
[*] Enemy structures now have range when hovering.
[*] Starting wood is reduced as it was too easy.
[*] Enemy towers became cheaper.
[*] End turn button now has indicator if anything is targeting your buildings.
[*] Some missing sounds added.
[/list]

Hope to hear more of your feedback

Have fun playing
Emilijus

notes.title: Seekers of Eclipse - Demo is coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone！

Seekers of Eclipse Demo is coming out on May 10th!

Demo will have 5 levels, 1 character, 50+ cards and 18 relics. In this update I want to show you new relics that got added after the Beta.

[b]Lucky Energy[/b] - If you produce exactly 7 resources it produces an additional Energy. 
[i]Fun power for the early game, becomes hard to manage for the late game, but the benefits are great[/i]


[b]Stolen Tools[/b] - Enemies don't build towers for the first 2 turns. 
[i]A great advantage for the early turns to build up the economy.[/i]


[b]Private Contract[/b] - You can buy Actions for gold. 
[i]Especially good on turns when you need just one more action.[/i]


[b]Resource Crates[/b] - Random resource pickups appear on the map.
[i]New feature that you can find a resource crates on the map that give you a random resource.[/i]

Thats it for now, hope to see you in the demo!
Emilijus

notes.content:
Hey, this month I finished work on all map locations and now will move on to implementing relics. There will be 6 different locations in the demo:
Market, Temple, Graveyard, Gold Mine, Tavern, Camp

In the Market you will have an opportunity to buy any of the offered goods as long as you have the money. In the offer there will always be 5 cards, 3 relics, an upgrade any card offer and remove any card offer. Some items in the offer will sometimes be on sale.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExN3A0Znd2ZTZncTdkNzNoOGtvbjNibDZ2ZGNzaWwzc21tYWprdjJmMSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ioAI3IuYqqDThx3TrT/source.gif[/img]


In the Tavern you will get an offer of getting one new card that you can choose from 3 available.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExanhjaHk5MHFhdXd1N3MwOGU5cjVjZm84bmk4Y3liazFlYW1rYzY5YSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/9KRUoGWJAqJgJQ7LaT/source.gif[/img]


In the Temple you will be offered a relic. When taking it there will be a chance of a getting a curse along with it. Each relic will change gameplay in some way.

Next time I will introduce relics and their effects.

Have a great day,
Emilijus

notes.title: Guide for traveling through the Dark Lands
notes.content:
Hey. This month I worked on the campaign part of the game.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmViZXhjbHl6dDFvN3JlOXR0anduNnM1ampsZm1peTFjM2ZsY2k3OSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/KHN3B2hOzmK4f58GWL/source.gif[/img]

Between each encounter with the enemy you will travel through the Dark Lands towards the next encounter. The start and finish are set, but what you do in between is your choice.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExemF3MDFwenZoODk3cnc4N29pZ2ZtNDcwdTVvdXowY3o5dDBheDFvYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0raptYDtuw8ceBYIjo/source.gif[/img]

The path is made from different locations. Traveling between locations costs time in days, which you can't spend too much as time is limited until the eclipse. When you run out of days you lose.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZTZ6enY4OGFhNXUwdHh2OWh3aHFkOGZjZnZiZWx2Mnl5M3NrbHdjZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/f3pKFx7nQ8ItFhHFvv/source.gif[/img]

Each location will provide you a different way to improve your city deck or find new relics which give you special powers.

Next time I will write about what each location does or a preview of relics, which do you want to hear more about?

Have a great day,
Emilijus
